drawing.title: CUI SDS-50J rev D (2006-08-22); positions also on Same Sky SDS-J page 3 (2024-09-12)

provenance.positions: Dimensioned PCB layout and side view: E at 2.5, pins 1-3 at 12.5, pins 4-5 at 15.0 from the front; x 2.5/5.0/7.5
provenance.section: Period drawing (2006): signal pins dimensioned 1.0 deep, drawn 0.5 wide; earth legs dimensioned 1.0 wide, drawn 0.32 thick, pointed (revision 13 used 0.70 x 1.00 and 1.00 x 0.21 drawn on the 2024 sheet)
provenance.omitted: Locating pegs are not added: the 2006 part shows screw bosses, not pegs, and the Eagle package has no holes for them

drawing.title: CUI MJ-3536N rev 1.02 (2020; mechanics unchanged since 2005)

provenance.positions: Dimensioned: terminal 1 at 2.3, terminal 3 at 13.5 (5.2 off axis), terminal 2 at 16.0 from the shoulder
provenance.section: Dimensioned widths 2.2 (terminal 1) and 2.0 (terminal 3); drawn thicknesses 0.40 / 0.20 / 0.34; terminal 2 width assumed equal to terminal 1 (hidden in the front view)
provenance.length: Dimensioned 4.5 below the body; dia 1.0 eyelets (3 places) in the rounded ends

provenance.positions: Dimensioned: A/C/B at 2.5 pitch 7.5 from centre, switch pins 5.00 apart 7.0 from centre, mounting tabs 11.10 apart
provenance.section: Dimensioned 0.8 +-0.1 pin width; 0.3 thickness and 0.6 x 2.2 tab section assumed from the 1.8 x 2.6 slots

provenance.positions: Dimensioned: six pins at 2.0 pitch, 11.0 from the tab line; snap-in tab slots 2.0 wide with 13.0 across their outer edges, so tab centres at +-5.5 (revision 13 misread 13.0 as the centre spacing)
provenance.section: Drawn 0.8 pin width; 0.3 thickness and 0.6 x 1.9 tab section assumed from the 2.0 x 2.1 slots
provenance.length: Dimensioned 3.5 (pins) and 3.2 (tabs) below the mounting surface

provenance.positions: Dimensioned piercing plan: #1-#3 at 2.5 pitch 7.00 from the tab line; tab slots 1.6 wide with 10.60 across their outer edges, so tab centres at +-4.50 (revision 13 misread 10.60 as the centre spacing)
provenance.section: Sister-type dimension 0.8 terminal width; 0.3 thickness and 0.6 x 2.0 tab section assumed from 1.6 x 2.2 slots

provenance.positions: Reference dimensions: pins 2.54 pitch 1.0 off centre; bracket legs 10.16 apart in columns 2.54 apart
